description: I am a seasoned education counsellor with 3 years of comprehensive experience supporting students across a wide spectrum of fields, including Engineering, MBA, BBA, Pharmacy, BCA, B.Com, Diploma in Engineering, B.Sc, Law, UPSC, Banking and Finance, Journalism and Mass Communication, M.Com, Cost and Management Accounting, HSC, MCA, and Hotel Management.
